title: Gaussian Process Regression-based Knowledge Distillation Framework for Simultaneous Prediction of Physical and Mechanical Properties of Epoxy Polymers
summary: Replaces separate property-prediction pipelines with one neural student distilled from GPR teachers using RDKit descriptors. It requires a GPR teacher per property, student training, and a curated experimental dataset covering 9 resins and 40 hardeners. Its molecular SMILES/RDKit inputs and materials-science task do not establish benefits for LLM or inference workloads.
rationale: A materials-science application of distillation outside the reader's LLM engineering and serving work.
technique: GPR distillation for polymer property prediction

claims.statement: Replaces separate property-prediction pipelines with one neural student distilled from GPR teachers using RDKit descriptors. It requires a GPR teacher per property, student training, and a curated experimental dataset covering 9 resins and 40 hardeners. Its molecular SMILES/RDKit inputs and materials-science task do not establish benefits for LLM or inference workloads.
Reports higher accuracy than conventional ML models, without figures in the abstract; shared information improves simultaneous prediction of multiple properties.
